ḍiṇḍima: [Ḍiṇḍi+mā+ṇa] (pu) CL=8 Mā mā ne sad de ca, I"m not sure if I"m going to be able to do that, but I"m sure I"m going to be able to do that. No. Dhan, Thi.14 3. Tindi + Mi + A. I"m not sure if I"m going to be able to do that, but I"m sure I"m going to be able to do that. [1) Ḍiṇḍima drum, short drum,  small drum. (2) ceremonial bronze drum. (3) two- headed drum flared at both ends.
